# K8 captured-telemetry validator — independent source review (fresh non-author)

## Verdict

**OrdinaryCaptureValidationReady: yes, for the exact one bounded ordinary run in `EXECUTION-PROPOSAL.json` only.** The four materialised candidate files are complete and correct as an ordinary captured-data parser correction. No blocker was found. This is not a native PASS, not proof acceptance, and not target qualification: the historical wrapper status **FAILED is preserved**, the 4 pairing outcomes remain the already-adopted 99541/85e captured predicate, and a post-run fresh actual audit is still required.

Source readiness, finite ordinary evidence, proposed authority and actual proof/target acceptance are distinct. Source readiness is yes as inspected text. Finite ordinary evidence is that the three pinned actual inputs satisfy every encoded check, so the proposed run is expected to write sole fresh `VALIDATION.json`; no run occurred in this review. Proposed authority is exactly one ordinary `python3 -I` run under the stated timeout/prlimit/minimal-env contract, with no new AUTH and no native prefix repeat.
